Description
APPLE INC has the following available in Austin, Texas. Understand the latest GPU design specifications provided by architects. Develop GPU Driver software using C and C++ programming languages to validate the GPU designs. Define, author, and troubleshoot APIs for GPU features with a focus on architectural, functional, and performance aspects. Develop production-grade automated processes using python, SQL for verifying our code base with a Continuous Integration system. Provide support to GPU hardware teams throughout the model, design, and deployment phases, both before and after silicon production. Offer assistance to GPU software teams during production driver implementation. 40 hours/week.

Minimum qualifications
Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering or related field and 2 years of experience in the job offered or related occupation.

Experience and/or education must include:

Utilizing C, C++ and Python to work on multi-language codebases.
Developing secure embedded system software for ARM based application processors.
Experience in HW and SW interaction using C and C++.
Utilizing Jenkins for continuous integration testing of software.
Automating the execution of software testing workflows on macOS or Linux.
Debugging complex failures using tools including GDB, LLDB or Visual Studio.
Using software versioning and performing releases using Git.
